resale_co.name: Certificate of Construction Records Clearance (CRC)
resale_co.issued_by: Delaware Township Office of the Construction Code Official
resale_co.lead_time: Submit the application and fee at least 10 business days before the change of ownership; the Township processes timely requests within 10 business days
resale_co.valid_for: Six months from the date of issue unless a change in occupancy has occurred
requirements: Records inspection for open construction permits and pending, open, unabated violations; all must be closed or cured before the CRC is issued
House number clearly displayed at the end of the driveway (listed on the form)
Form asks about swimming pool and pool fence (at least 4 feet high with self-closing and latching gates)
Form asks about finished basement, space above garage, hot tub, deck and alarm system, and asks the seller to list all outbuildings with approximate size
A provisional CRC may be issued when there is not enough time to close open permits, if owner and buyer acknowledge them in writing and agree on a plan

fees.label: CRC, request more than 10 business days before change of occupancy
fees.quote: Requests received more than 10 business days prior to change of occupancy - $75

fees.label: CRC, request 10 or fewer business days before change of occupancy
fees.quote: Requests received 10 or less business days prior to change of occupancy - $100

fees.label: Update request for same premises within 6 months of prior issuance
fees.quote: Update request for same premise within 6 months of prior issuance - $50

resale_co.how_to_apply: The seller or seller's agent completes the Construction Records Clearance Application - Residential (one per address) and submits it with cash or a check payable to Delaware Township to the Construction Office, 570 Rosemont Ringoes Road, Sergeantsville (PO Box 500).
resale_co.contact_title: Technical Assistant to the Construction Code Official

evidence.quote: The Construction Records Clearance is the responsibility of the seller or agent for the seller. One application per address is needed at the closing of the property.
Debbi Hutton, Technical Assistant to the Construction Code Official
A CRC shall be required prior to the sale of any residential or commercial structure.

The owner and/or authorized agent shall submit a written application and payment of fees at least 10 business days prior to the change of ownership and/or occupancy on the form provided by the Township.
CRC certificates are valid for six months from the date of issue unless a change in occupancy has occurred and must be renewed for each occupancy change.

resale_co.notes: Township Code Chapter 162 (fees amended 4-14-2025 by Ord. No. 2025-05 and 8-10-2026 by Ord. No. 2026-14) requires a CRC before the sale of any residential structure. The current form (revised 8/12/2026) matches the ordinance fees of $75 / $100 / $50. Older third-party listings and search snippets of the Township page mention a $35 fee and filing the smoke certificate with the State; both are out of date. Exemptions include deed corrections, transfers between spouses, estate distributions, refinancing and transfers to a bankruptcy trustee. Construction Official is Thomas Petto (inspections Tuesday and Thursday).

requirements: Smoke alarm on each level of the home and outside each separate sleeping area
Battery-only smoke alarms must be 10-year sealed battery units; hardwired alarms from original construction may not be replaced with battery alarms
Carbon monoxide alarm in the immediate vicinity of the sleeping areas (where there is a fuel-burning appliance or attached garage)
Secondary power source identification label, if the home has a secondary power source (Code 197-6, P.L.2025, c.19)
Portable fire extinguisher in date and in compliance (the fire district form still lists it, and Code 197-6E(7) lists an out-of-date extinguisher as a failure reason)

authorities.name: Lambertville Fire District #1 Bureau of Fire Safety (shared service with Delaware Township since July 1, 2026)
authorities.lead_time: Allow at least 1 to 2 weeks for mailed applications; fees step up at 10 and 4 business days before the change of occupancy

fees.label: Smoke/CO certificate, request more than 10 business days before change of occupancy
fees.quote: Requests for CSACMASPSIL received more than 10 business days prior to change of occupancy shall be $75.

fees.label: Request 4 to 10 business days before change of occupancy
fees.quote: Requests for CSACMASPSIL received four to 10 business days prior to the change of occupancy shall be $125.

fees.label: Request fewer than 4 business days before change of occupancy
fees.quote: Requests for CSACMASPSIL received fewer than four business days prior to the change of occupancy shall be $175.

fees.label: Same-day inspection (ordinance)
fees.quote: Same day only. Requests for CSACMASPSIL for the same day as the application is turned in or of the original inspection date, the fee shall be $250.

fees.label: Re-inspection (failed inspection, no-show or incomplete application)
fees.quote: Re-inspection fee for CSDCMAC shall be $50.00

authorities.how_to_apply: Complete the Lambertville Fire District #1 application for smoke alarm, carbon monoxide alarm and fire extinguisher compliance and submit it with a check payable to Lambertville Fire District # 1, 230 N. Main St., Lambertville, NJ 08530. Forms and payments can also be submitted electronically on the fire district website.

evidence.quote: Fire Prevention services are provided through a shared service agreement between the Township of Delaware and Lambertville Fire District #1.
Forms and payments can also be submitted electronically on their website.
This application is filed with Lambertville Fire District #1.

Before any one- or two-family or attached single-family dwelling is sold, leased, or otherwise made subject to a change of occupancy for residential purposes, the owner shall apply for a Certificate of Smoke Alarm, Carbon Monoxide Alarm, and Secondary Power Source Identification Label Compliance (CSACMASPSIL).
Lambertville Fire Dist 1 is the SAA for Delaware Twp. (Delaware moved from State to District)
Delaware Township1007 LEAID: 1007-001 Enf Auth. District Fire Official Frank Ur Phone (609) 681-7913 Email firemarshal17@lfddistrict1.com

fire_cert.notes: Delaware Township moved from State fire code enforcement to Lambertville Fire District #1 (LEA code D; July 2026 registry), and the Township Fire Prevention page says the shared service started July 1, 2026. Code 197-6 (amended 7-13-2026 by Ord. No. 2026-13) renames the certificate CSACMASPSIL (smoke alarm, CO alarm and secondary power source ID label) and sets $75 / $125 / $175 and $250 for same-day requests. The fire district application posted on the Township site lists the same first three fees but $225.00 for same-day inspections, and it still lists a portable fire extinguisher, which P.L.2025, c.19 dropped from the state sale certificate; the ordinance itself still lists an out-of-date extinguisher as a failure reason. The state fire directory entry (survey 2/12/2021) still shows the NJ Division of Fire Safety address with Frank Ur as fire official and phone (609) 681-7913; the fire district station line is 609-397-2084.
